arguments.body:
# Farewell line

_Draft, with the user._

## Purpose

Add a farewell line to hello, alongside its greeting.

## Checks

Check README.md keeps its greeting and contains one farewell line.

## Open questions

Where should the farewell line go?
Recommendation: at the end of README.md so it closes the page.

turns:
I wrote the farewell draft beside us. Where should the farewell line go?

1. At the end of README.md — it closes the page
2. In its own file — the greeting stays alone
3. Tell me something else

arguments.body:
Put the farewell line at the end of README.md.
No open questions block the work.

turns: I settled the location at the end of README.md. The draft is ready; nothing blocks the work.
